column1: # role is client or server: the bug is in that role of the adapter only; without
# it, in either role. @peer: it shows only when that adapter is at the other end
# (for example because only that peer offers what triggers it). The upstream
# version is the pin of versions.yaml. The test id regex matches the test ids of
# scripts/interop.sh. The evidence URL points to the upstream issue or commit.
# The waiver id names the entry in results.json; never change it.
# A known-bug entry that does not reproduce in a run where its tests ran is a
# stale entry, and fails the run (scripts/interop.sh).

column5: get_seq() formats a list href and its query into char uri[64]; the DERControlList href of GridAPPS-D (about 70 to 100 characters) overflows it and client_test crashes (Bus error) before it reads a control or responds to one
client_test sends every document in the draft sep.xsd 2.0.4 name space http://ieee.org/2030.5, not urn:ieee:std:2030.5:ns of IEEE 2030.5-2018; GridAPPS-D refuses its MirrorUsagePoint with 400

client_test parses strictly by its sep.xsd 2.0.4 and rejects the CSIP-AUS extension element csipaus:ConnectionPointLink that Envoy adds to EndDevice (parse error in message body), so it gets no further than the EndDeviceList

py20305 writes the CSIP-AUS extensions (doeModesSupported, doeModesEnabled) in the namespace https://csipaus.org/ns; Envoy reads only https://csipaus.org/ns/v1.3 and refuses the DERCapability PUT with 400 (doeModesSupported missing)

CSIP-AUS 1.3 (csipaus-core-v1.3.xsd) extends TimeTariffInterval with a mandatory RateComponentLink in the IEEE 2030.5 namespace, which Envoy serves; py20305 does not model it, rejects the TimeTariffIntervalList and finds no interval
